periods.time: War conclusion and early Quedland recovery
periods.label: 亲手击碎傀儡王头颅后仍背负伤痛的奎多兰王子

name.zh: 约翰·克里斯多夫·冯·柯布兰德
name.jp: ジョン＝クリストフ＝フォン＝コブランド

periods.occupation: prince; war survivor; future national leader

status.current: alive and working with Lunaeyes to explain the war to Quedland's people; expected to marry Lunaeyes
status.condition: physically weak and emotionally devastated by the deaths of family, friends and citizens
status.goal: console and lead Quedland with Lunaeyes's support

personality.summary: Grief-stricken and self-blaming, but still able to act when given a chance at justice and support.

relationships.or-gaule: Former controller and murderer of his family and people; John destroys his head in revenge before Danse Macabre activates.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Cousin and liberator; she throws Or-Gaule to him and later consoles him by reminding him he protected Lunaeyes.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Beloved supporter; she rides with him during the execution and remains at his side through postwar recovery.
relationships.quedland-citizens: Former puppeted subjects who hail his action as liberation.

periods.summary: After Stella dismembers Or-Gaule, she throws the helpless terrorist upward to John. With Lunaeyes supporting him on his golden warhorse, John uses Circus Maximus to impale Or-Gaule through the mouth and smash his head, seemingly avenging his murdered family, friends and citizens. When Or-Gaule's control breaks, Quedland citizens regain their bodies and celebrate John's role in saving them. John then breaks down, thanking Stella but calling himself useless because he failed to protect his parents, friends and people. Stella tells him that he protected Lunaeyes and should not turn the dead into curses against himself. Lunaeyes's silent presence helps him regain enough strength to tend to the confused citizens. Three days later Stella reports that John and Lunaeyes are explaining events to Quedland's people and will probably stabilize the country. Their future marriage will also lead Lunaeyes to renounce Vermillion succession, making Stella the next heir.

key_events.summary: Rides with Lunaeyes through Divine Gate and destroys Or-Gaule's head.
Is reported to be stabilizing Quedland with Lunaeyes and preparing for marriage.
